follow-up time: until subsequent delivery or end of study period
cohort: 14 women clinically suspected with AFE (12 of whom met international diagnostic criteria) at a tertiary medical centre between 2003 and 2018
finding: Applying international diagnostic criteria for amniotic fluid embolism (AFE) to suspected cases resulted in a precise diagnosis, with high clinical accuracy; subsequent pregnancies in survivors were not associated with AFE recurrence.
